definitions.explanation: Tableware designed for Japanese cuisine, including items such as rice bowls, soup bowls, small plates, and chopstick rests. Typically made of ceramics, lacquerware, or wood.

examples.japanese: {和食器|わしょっき}で{食事|しょくじ}をする。
{和食器|わしょっき}は{料理|りょうり}を{美|うつく}しく{見|み}せてくれる。
examples.english: Japanese tableware makes food look beautiful.

examples.japanese: {結婚|けっこん}{祝|いわ}いに{有名|ゆうめい}な{窯元|かまもと}の{和食器|わしょっき}セットを{贈|おく}った。
examples.english: I gave a set of Japanese tableware from a famous kiln as a wedding gift.

notes:
A compound of {和|わ} (Japanese-style) and {食器|しょっき} (tableware). Encompasses the full range of dishes and utensils used in Japanese cuisine. Japanese tableware is notable for its variety — unlike Western place settings where items match, Japanese meals typically feature an assortment of differently shaped and sized vessels chosen to complement each dish.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {和食器|わしょっき}セット: Japanese tableware set
- {和食器|わしょっき}を{集|あつ}める: to collect Japanese tableware
- {手作|てづく}りの{和食器|わしょっき}: handmade Japanese tableware

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {洋食器|ようしょっき}: Western tableware — plates, forks, knives, etc.
- {食器|しょっき}: tableware; dishes — general term covering both Japanese and Western styles
- {陶器|とうき}: pottery; ceramics — the material, not the category of use
